q.en: How far in advance should I order?

a.bs: Za torte najmanje 3 dana, za kolače i mini deserte 2 dana, a za slavljeničke i dvospratne torte 7 ili više dana. U sezoni (maturalne, svadbe, praznici) termini se brzo popune, pa je bolje javiti se ranije.
a.en: At least 3 days for cakes, 2 days for pastries and mini desserts, and 7 or more days for celebration and tiered cakes. Dates fill up fast in busy seasons (proms, weddings, holidays), so it's best to get in touch early.

a.bs: Da - dostava na području Mostara košta 5 KM. Za dostavu izvan Mostara javite nam se i dogovorit ćemo se. Lično preuzimanje je uvijek besplatno.
a.en: Yes - delivery within Mostar costs 5 BAM. For delivery outside Mostar, get in touch and we'll arrange it. Pickup is always free.

a.bs: Plaćanje je gotovinom prilikom preuzimanja ili dostave. Za slavljeničke torte i veće narudžbe uzima se avans koji dogovaramo pri potvrdi narudžbe.
a.en: Payment is in cash on pickup or delivery. For celebration cakes and larger orders we take a deposit, agreed when your order is confirmed.

q.bs: Možete li napraviti tortu bez šećera, glutena ili orašastih plodova?
q.en: Can you make sugar-free, gluten-free or nut-free cakes?

a.bs: Za neke torte možemo prilagoditi recept - napišite to u napomeni pri narudžbi. Imajte na umu da u kuhinji koristimo gluten, orašaste plodove, jaja i mlijeko, pa ne možemo garantovati potpuno odsustvo tragova.
a.en: We can adapt some recipes - just add a note to your order. Please keep in mind our kitchen uses gluten, nuts, eggs and dairy, so we can't guarantee a product is completely free of traces.

q.en: How should I store the cake?

a.bs: Torte i kremaste kolače čuvajte u frižideru i iznesite ih 15-20 minuta prije služenja. Najbolje su u roku od 2-3 dana.
a.en: Keep cakes and cream pastries in the fridge and take them out 15-20 minutes before serving. They're best within 2-3 days.

q.bs: Mogu li naručiti iz inostranstva za porodicu u Mostaru?
q.en: Can I order from abroad for my family in Mostar?

a.bs: Naravno! Naručite preko stranice ili WhatsAppa, upišite ime i adresu osobe kojoj šaljete tortu, a mi ćemo se pobrinuti za ostalo. Plaćanje dogovaramo pri potvrdi.
a.en: Of course! Order through the site or WhatsApp, enter the name and address of the person you're sending the cake to, and we'll take care of the rest. We'll agree on payment when we confirm.
